name: Octree Hashing for Point Location and Neighbor Finding
definition: A coordinate system where octree cells are defined on the interval [0, 2^dmax]. Vectors in this space are cast to integers to perform point location and neighbor finding without floating-point arithmetic.
summary: Octree Hashing performs point location and neighbor finding in implicit octrees using integer coordinate hashing and bitwise arithmetic, avoiding explicit parent pointers and expensive shifts.
